title: Models of matter change over time

draft.title: Models of matter change over time
card: A model is an idea or picture that helps scientists explain what they observe. Scientists change a model when new evidence does not fit it.
an ancient Greek thinker who proposed that matter is made of tiny particles that cannot be divided. He called them atoms. His idea came from reasoning, not from experiments.
a scientist in the early 1800s who built atomic theory from experiments. He proposed that each element is made of its own kind of atom, and that atoms join in set ways to form compounds.
Later experiments and better instruments gave new evidence about atoms, so the model kept changing. A model that changes is not a failure. It shows science using new evidence.
draft.remember: Models of matter change when new evidence from experiments and instruments does not fit the old model.

a.q: Why did ideas about atoms change from Democritus's model to Dalton's?
opts: Dalton used experiments to give evidence for atoms
Dalton showed that Democritus had made an error in reasoning
Dalton had access to better microscopes than Democritus
Dalton was more famous, so people accepted his model
a.why: Dalton built his theory from experiments, so it had evidence behind it. Microscopes were not the reason: the card says Democritus used reasoning, and Dalton relied on experimental evidence.
a.clue: Think about where each person's idea came from.

b.q: A scientist finds that a new instrument gives results that her current model of the atom cannot explain. What would scientists most likely do?
opts: Change the model so that it fits the new evidence
Ignore the results because the model is already accepted
Keep the model because models never change once published
Throw out all earlier work on atoms as worthless
b.why: Scientists change a model when new evidence does not fit it. Keeping the model unchanged ignores the evidence, and earlier work still helped lead to the improved model.
b.clue: What do scientists do when evidence does not fit a model?

a.best: Dalton used experiments to give evidence for atoms

b.best: Change the model so that it fits the new evidence
